h1: Design and custom build of an executive office, 7 m²

blocks.text: Design and custom build of an executive office, 7 m²

parts.html: A 7 m² executive office in an attic: we did the interior design project and 3D visualization and designed the custom furniture. The room is long and narrow, with a sloping ceiling and a roof window. A full workstation had to fit into this space, so the interior and furniture were designed as one, to the exact dimensions of this room. The gallery shows 3D visualizations of the office.

Built-in furniture runs along both long walls. On the tall section of wall are floor-to-ceiling cabinets with smooth handleless fronts. Where the ceiling slopes down there are open shelves, their tops cut to the line of the slope. The desk sits toward the end of the room, under the roof window, so daylight falls on it from above. At the far end is a low cabinet with fluted fronts that holds the printer.

The oak veneer desktop joins the built-in furniture at one end and rests on a transparent leg at the other. In a narrow office the desk does not block the way through and looks lighter. At the desk are two identical chairs on slim metal bases, one for the owner of the office and one for a visitor.

The floor is large-format porcelain tile that looks like white marble with brown veining. It sets the main pattern, so the walls are kept quiet: fronts in light oak veneer and wall panels with fine vertical slats in a gray-beige tone. The ceiling and the slope are white. The backs of the shelving niches have a textured finish, with LED strips hidden along the sides: in the evening the shelves with books and ceramics give off soft extra light. On the desk is a lamp with a frosted globe.

blocks.text: Furniture made to fit the attic

parts.html: The cabinets, the shelving under the slope, the desk and the low cabinet were designed and made to order from the room’s measurements. In an attic this is the only way to use the low part of the wall: ready-made catalog modules would leave empty triangles under the ceiling.
We do commercial interior design and design custom furniture for offices, executive offices, stores, boutiques and beauty salons in Bratislava and Vienna.
